mapper.select:
select widget.id as widget_id, rule_config.id as parse_rule_id, device.id as device_satellite_id, device.type as device_type, device.code as device_code, device.name as device_name, selection.telemetry_code, rule_config.telemetry_name, rule_config.system_name as system_path from monitor_dashboard_widget widget inner join processed_telemetry_filter_selection selection on selection.task_id = widget.task_id and selection.target_id = widget.id and selection.selection_type = case when widget.widget_type = 1 then 4 else 3 end and selection.is_deleted = 0 left join device_satellite device on device.id = selection.device_satellite_id and device.task_id = widget.task_id and device.is_deleted = 0 left join telemetry_parse_rule_config rule_config on rule_config.task_id = widget.task_id and rule_config.device_satellite_id = device.id and rule_config.telemetry_code = selection.telemetry_code and rule_config.is_deleted = 0 where widget.widget_type in (1, 2)
order by widget.id, device.type, device.code, selection.telemetry_code

select item.widget_id, item.parse_rule_id, item.interface_id, item.protocol_config_id, item.item_code, item.item_name, (item.is_selected = 1) as selected, interface_config.interface_name, protocol_config.config_name as protocol_config_name from monitor_dashboard_widget widget inner join monitor_widget_config_item item on item.widget_id = widget.id left join collect_interface_config interface_config on interface_config.id = item.interface_id and interface_config.task_id = widget.task_id and interface_config.is_deleted = 0 left join collect_protocol_config protocol_config on protocol_config.id = item.protocol_config_id and protocol_config.task_id = widget.task_id and protocol_config.is_deleted = 0 where 1 = 1
order by widget.id, item.id

select rule_config.id as parse_rule_id, device.id as device_satellite_id, device.type as device_type, device.code as device_code, device.name as device_name, rule_config.telemetry_code, rule_config.telemetry_name, rule_config.system_name as system_path from telemetry_parse_rule_config rule_config inner join device_satellite device on device.id = rule_config.device_satellite_id and device.task_id = rule_config.task_id and device.is_deleted = 0 where rule_config.is_deleted = 0
and rule_config.task_id = #{taskId} and
(device.type = #{parameter.deviceType} and device.code = #{parameter.deviceCode} and rule_config.telemetry_code = #{parameter.telemetryCode})
and 1 = 0

when.test: taskId != null and taskId != '' and names != null and names.size() > 0

(nextval('monitor_widget_config_item_id_seq'), #{item.widgetId}, #{item.parseRuleId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{item.interfaceId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{item.protocolConfigId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{item.itemCode}, #{item.itemName}, #{item.isSelected})
